maria (auditor): Hi team — auditor request. For the RBAC change that fixed CVE-2026-0421 yesterday, can you provide the approval trail (who approved, timestamps), PR/commit links, and the rollout timeline? Also need KMS-related evidence: Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, CMK id/alias, and proof key rotation hasn’t happened mid-rollout. Please include a 1h-before to 2h-after log snapshot and a signed bundle hash for chain-of-custody.

elaine (sec): Got it. Patch was merged and rolled out via infra repo. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinfra/infra/pull/1248 commit 9f1b2a3. Approvals in GH: @sec_lead approved 2026-03-20T02:58:03Z, @eng_platform approved 2026-03-20T03:01:10Z. Label: security/patch. Will assemble RBAC diff and list of affected roles.

chris (oncall): Context from oncall: incident INC-2026-42 opened at 2026-03-20T03:05Z during rollout; ran the rollback gatecheck but we stayed with patch after canary. Small spike in 503s for inference-worker-3 between 03:12–03:18 UTC, logged and triaged as transient retry. No auth anomalies.

devon (infra): KMS notes: CMK alias is alias/redwood-prod-kms (key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01-2345). CloudTrail events to pull: EventName=Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt. We did not rotate the CMK during the window; last rotation 2025-12-01.

chris (oncall): Quick export commands (will attach sanitized output):

```
# CloudTrail lookup for KMS decrypts
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-20T05:00:00Z --query Events

# CloudWatch logs filter for rollout window
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/ecs/inference --start-time 1710910320000 --end-time 1710910448000 --filter-pattern "ROLLOUT OR RBAC"
```

elaine (sec): RBAC change was applied via terraform: path infra/iam/roles.tf (PR explains the exact policy delta). Affected service accounts: svc-inference, svc-ingest, svc-monitor. I'll produce a CSV with last-used timestamps from CloudTrail for those principals.

maria (auditor): For the bundle we need: presigned S3 link to the export, sha256 of the tarball, who uploaded it, and S3 access logs for that object. Also confirm which identities had access to the key used to decrypt any logs (list roles/policies).

evidence-bot: evidence-bot: export job created — s3://redwood-evidence/exports/1866666666-rbac-patch-20260320.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7d). Upload user: infra-ci@redwood (service principal).

devon (infra): I'll generate the SHA256 and sign with our artifacts key. Signed manifest preview: sha256: 3b7d9c1a9f2e4d8c6a0f5b1e2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d. Will attach the PEM signature and upload to same bucket under manifests/.

chris (oncall): Adding runbook excerpt to the bundle: incident timeline, canary health check outputs, rollback decisions, and the one-line mitigation confirmation. Also attaching the commit comment that references CVE-2026-0421.

elaine (sec): I'll add an evidence note confirming no key rotation during rollout and include KMS key policy snapshot + CloudTrail Decrypt event list (with truncated principal ARNs). ETA ~2 hours.

maria (auditor): Good. Last ask: please include a short signed note from @sec_lead certifying that the RBAC change was authorized and was the minimal privilege required. Also include retention policy for the export and proof of who accessed the S3 object (access log). Once we have the signed manifest and logs I'll close this request.

elaine (sec): @maria noted — I'll chase sec_lead for signature and put everything in the evidence bundle. Posting the final bundle link and manifest here when ready. :thumbsup:
